_doc: Territorial bestiary. Creatures ignore you until provoked. Radii in metres. senses: hearing/vision/light/blood/food/vibration weights (light < 0 = repelled by light). temperament: shy (flees if you back off), protective (guards until you leave), ambusher (hidden until you are very close), skittish (strikes when surprised). warnTime = seconds of threat display before an attack. leash = how far past its territory it will follow. damage per hit; bleed adds to the bleeding rate. lethal: contact can kill outright (after the first hour). stub: data only, not yet in the world.

gullrat.name: Gullrats
signs: Droppings and feathers on deck rails
A high chittering under the planks after dark
weak: Sealed storage gives them nothing to want
Traps and noise-baits on the edge of the deck
notes: Gulls and rats, nesting together under the rafts. A swarm, not an animal.
They come for open food and for eggs. They do not care about you unless you smell of either.
A swarm can strip a sleeping body of its rations and skin in minutes. Keep a lamp lit.

siltwolf.name: Siltwolves
signs: Watching shapes on a far roof
weak: Lights and noise make them keep their distance
High ground; they will not climb ladders
Never run: running is what prey does
notes: Dogs once. Webbed feet now, grey with silt. They swim between roofs in the evening.
They watch. They growl if you come near the den. They come for you only if you corner them, come between them and the pups, or run.
A pack will follow a runner a long way. Back away slowly, face them, keep a light on them.

needlefish.name: Needlefish
signs: Silver flickers just under the surface
weak: Stay out of the water while bleeding
Fire on the water drives them deep
notes: Hand-long fish with jaws like a sewing needle. Thousands of them in the warm shallows.
A slow swimmer is just another shape. A splasher is a wounded thing. Blood in the water is an invitation.
A shoal in a frenzy draws worse things up from below.

netweaver.name: Net-Weavers
signs: Pale threads hanging in still water
Dead fish caught at head height
A faint bell-shape against the dark
weak: Touch nothing: they only sting what brushes the threads
A blade cuts a path through the threads
notes: A drifting bell the size of a car, trailing threads that sting like boiling water.
It does not hunt. Threads that are touched, or a light shone into the bell, make it flare and lash.
The sting stops the breath for a moment. Divers drown from the panic, not the venom.

listener.name: Listeners
listener.habitat: the dark: stations, the Shelf, the Sounding
signs: Lanternfish going dark all at once
Scraping on metal that is not you
weak: Air pockets: they will not surface
notes: Pale, tall, many-limbed. Blind. They hold the dark places and wait.
They hear everything: engines, splashes, a dropped tool, running feet, a sonar ping. They hunt the sound.
Contact is death. Stay slow. Stay quiet. Let them pass.

bloomwalker.name: Bloomwalkers
signs: Soft green light in drowned windows
The growth thickening on a doorway
weak: Keep the light off them and keep moving
Salt or cold makes the glow let go
If one holds you: struggle, then swim up
notes: People. Were people. The growth took them under and keeps them drifting.
They turn toward light and warmth. If you stand still near one, or light it up, it holds on.
They are slow, and they are sad, and they will drown you without meaning to.

tide_crab.name: Tide Crabs
notes: Armoured scavengers the size of a car. Slow. They only fight what steps on them.

spore_heron.name: Spore Herons
notes: Tall birds with lit eyes. Their spores make the water look like it is breathing.

cable_eel.name: Cable Eels
notes: They live in dead cables that are not quite dead. Test the water with a rod.

hullbiter.name: Hullbiters
notes: Barnacle-armoured. They eat wood from below. A leak that wasn't there yesterday.

drowned_pack.name: Drowned Packs
notes: Blind white fish that turn on sound like one animal.

choir.name: The Choir
notes: Their songs move the water. Rafts above them tip and break.

warden.name: The Warden of the Cathedral
notes: Something guards the Cathedral. Teo's last recording is mostly its sound.

raft_raid.text: Scratching. Wings. Something on the deck, right by your pack. It smells the food.

street_dive.hint: Ahead, pale threads hang in the still water, moving with no current. Something big and soft drifts above them.

listener_crawl.hint: The station is too quiet. Something here is listening. Do not make a sound.
